title: Annotatio II §.I close: Order of treatment — consub first, spiritual last, transub middle (Spanhemius); stop before §.II
pass_a_gloss: Yet beginning from that part of it which in this Elenchus of Controversies is chiefly opposed to us, and ending last in ours as its antithesis, but inserting the middle one — mentioned by author Spanhemius for kinship with the first alone — between the two named.
pass_b_english: Order: start with Consubstantiation — the part chiefly opposed to us in this Elenchus; end with ours (Spiritual Presence) as its antithesis.
Insert Transubstantiation in the middle only for kinship with the first, as Spanhemius notes.
source_text: Ab istâ tamen ejus parte facto initio, quae nobis in hoc Controversiarum Elencho potissimum opposita est, inque nostra, ceu illius antithesi, postremò defituri, mediam verò, ob solam cum prima cognationem, authore Spanhemio memoratam, duabus nominatis interferturi.
